If you have the skills above and pass a police check and can work the hours then apply now.

job.title: Business Analyst
job.description:
Business Analyst
Location: Parramatta 
Rate: $90-$125.70/hr + Super
Hybrid: 3 days in office
Start: ASAP
End Date: 31st December (possible extensions)
 
Business Analyst
 
About the Role
 
We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to support the delivery of digital solutions within a complex business environment. You will work closely with stakeholders and technical teams to understand business needs, define requirements and translate them into clear, actionable outcomes.
 
This role will suit a Business Analyst who is comfortable working across both business and technology teams and can manage competing priorities while ensuring solutions remain aligned with business objectives.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Facilitate workshops and requirements gathering sessions with key stakeholders.
  • Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Gather, analyse and document functional and technical requirements.
  • Develop clear user stories and contribute to backlog management.
  • Translate complex business needs into requirements that technical teams can deliver against.
  • Maintain traceability between business requirements and delivered solutions.
  • Support testing and validation activities to ensure solutions meet requirements.
  • Work collaboratively with stakeholders, delivery teams and technical specialists.
  • Help ensure technology solutions align with broader business strategies and objectives.
About You
To be successful in this role, you will have:
  • 4+ years' experience working as a Business Analyst or in a related role.
  • Proven experience in business analysis within digital delivery environments.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, communication and facilitation skills.
  • Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including user stories and backlog management.
  • An understanding of relational database and client-server concepts.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex requirements and competing priorities.
  • Experience with tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • The ability to confidently translate business requirements into clear technical requirements for delivery teams.
What You'll Bring
 
You will be a proactive and collaborative Business Analyst who can operate comfortably between business stakeholders and technical teams. You will bring strong judgement, attention to detail and the ability to understand complex business problems and develop practical solutions.
The role offers the opportunity to work on meaningful digital delivery initiatives while collaborating with a range of stakeholders and delivery specialists.
The role's core focus is supporting digital solution delivery through business analysis, requirements definition and collaboration between stakeholders and technical teams.

job.title: Solution Architect
job.description:
About the Role

An opportunity is available for an experienced Solution Architect to join a technology project team supporting a diverse portfolio of enterprise programs within a large higher education and health environment.

The project team consists of approximately 20 professionals across program management, business analysis and technology disciplines, supporting around 10 concurrent programs of varying complexity, scale and vendor involvement.

The Solution Architect will work closely with Project Managers, business stakeholders and technology teams to design solution architectures that integrate effectively with existing enterprise systems. The role will contribute across multiple projects and programs, providing architectural guidance through solution design, documentation, governance and review processes.

The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between different projects and working across a broad range of stakeholders, technologies and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design and Architecture
  • Design and document technology solutions that meet business, technical and security requirements.
  • Work closely with Project Managers and business stakeholders to understand requirements and develop appropriate architectural solutions.
  • Develop high-level and detailed solution architecture documentation, diagrams and integration designs.
  • Assess how proposed solutions integrate with existing enterprise systems and platforms.
  • Facilitate solution design discussions and contribute architectural expertise across multiple concurrent projects.
Architecture Governance
  • Participate in architecture and security reviews throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Apply established architecture principles, standards and best practices to solution designs.
  • Ensure solutions consider relevant security, integration and governance requirements.
  • Maintain architecture documentation and contribute to architecture repositories and governance processes.
Technology & Integration
  • Provide architectural guidance across cloud, SaaS, API and enterprise integration environments.
  • Contribute to projects involving AWS, Azure, Microsoft 365 and SaaS platforms.
  • Design and assess API and system integration solutions.
  • Support enterprise projects involving health technology, data platforms, corporate systems and integration with Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems.
  • Contribute to initiatives focused on transforming and integrating health data into common enterprise platforms.
Stakeholder Engagement
  • Build effective relationships with business stakeholders, Project Managers, technology teams and vendors.
  • Work collaboratively with business and project teams to translate business requirements into practical technology solutions.
  • Facilitate workshops and design discussions with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Communicate complex architectural concepts clearly to a broad range of stakeholders.
  • Provide flexibility across multiple projects and programs, adapting to changing priorities and requirements.
Technology Assessment & Continuous Improvement
  • Research and assess technology options and contribute to technology evaluations and recommendations.
  • Support proof-of-concepts and the evaluation of new platforms and technologies.
  • Contribute to the adoption of technologies and ways of working that improve business and operational outcomes.
Key Experience & Skills The successful candidate will have:
  • Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect within complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience developing and facilitating solution architecture and design documentation.
  • Experience working across both high-level enterprise architecture and detailed solution design.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work across business, technology, project and vendor environments.
  • Demonstrated experience across one or more major cloud platforms, particularly AWS and/or Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, SaaS platforms, APIs and enterprise integrations.
  • Experience designing solutions that integrate with existing enterprise systems and platforms.
  • Ability to work across multiple concurrent projects and programs with varying levels of complexity.
  • Strong understanding of architecture governance, security considerations and technology standards.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills.
Desirable:
  • Experience within the higher education sector.
  • Experience working within health-related technology environments.
  • Exposure to Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems and health data platforms.
